driver: The decisive quantity is a forward requirement priced from a fixed-plus-variable cost structure recovered exactly from historical per-unit shares, because carrying the per-unit shares onto a denser future period re-pays the fixed component once per unit and overstates the requirement.
driver_concrete: The shipped planned_service_minutes is each drop's share of a depot-sector-day loop (stem plus running plus service), so the loop is recovered exactly from 28,975 sector-days and the denser October book re-priced as route plans, filing 31 duties where carried account shares file 37.
stump: A solver who carries each account's mean shipped minutes per drop onto the October register book and sizes the peak trading day depot by depot files 37 duties, because summing shares across a denser day re-pays each sector-day's fixed stem once per drop (designed decoy, not yet measured on the portal).
